# Hollywood Hideaways

> Two private, fully furnished 2-bedroom garden bungalows in central Hollywood, Los Angeles, rented for stays of 30 nights or more. Book direct at https://hollywoodhideaways.com (about 7% below Airbnb) or on Airbnb. Hosted by John, an Airbnb Superhost since 2015 with a 4.97 average across 342 reviews.

## The homes

Both are halves of a renovated 1916 bungalow duplex at De Longpre Ave and Cherokee Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90028, behind a ten-foot privacy hedge, two blocks south of Sunset Blvd and directly across from De Longpre Park.

- **De Longpre** (front unit): 2 bedrooms (two queens) plus a queen sleeper sofa, 1 bath with skylight and tub, sleeps 6. Private fenced yard with a deck under a century-old avocado tree. 4.98 from 306 reviews. Airbnb: https://airbnb.com/h/delongpre
- **Cherokee** (back unit): 2 bedrooms (two queens), 1 bath with skylight and marble bench, sleeps 4. Its own fenced garden and a deck that seats six. Airbnb: https://airbnb.com/h/cherokee

Both have a full kitchen, in-unit washer and dryer, central air and heat, fast Wi-Fi, a dedicated workspace, Apple TV, keyless entry, a high chair and Pack 'n Play.

## Stays and prices

- Minimum stay 30 nights; many guests stay 2 to 4 months.
- Direct rate: $4,800 a month for either home, cleaning included; $100 a month off for bank transfer or cash. No security deposit for most stays.
- Pets considered case by case; dogs are regularly welcome. Families with babies are welcome.
- Street parking permit included; a gated driveway spot is $150 a month.
- Check-in 3 PM, checkout 11 AM.

## Good fit for

Film and TV work, relocating to Los Angeles, remote work, athletes in town to train, new parents, and anyone who wants a quiet, private garden in walking distance of Hollywood. Returning guests get first call on dates.

## Nearby

Hollywood Walk of Fame (about 10 minutes on foot), the Pantages, TCL Chinese Theatre, Hollywood Bowl, Runyon Canyon (5 minutes by car). Hollywood/Vine and Hollywood/Highland Metro stations are walkable; Universal Studios is one stop on the B Line.
